system.description:
Pockets full of things that shouldn't work as well as they do. You're never quite out of options, just out of Ingenuity Points.

  • Quickbuild Gadget (1st): As an action, spend 1 Ingenuity Point to produce a single-use gadget from your known list (smoke bomb, grapnel line, shock glove, flash powder, etc.) — effect equivalent to a 1st-level spell or utility effect, GM-adjudicated case by case. You can hold built gadgets equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your Artificer level; extras go inert.
  • Reusable Chassis (3rd): One gadget of your choice (a Grapnel Line or Shock Glove are popular picks) becomes reusable rather than single-use, recharging on a full rest instead of costing Ingenuity each use.
  • Rapid Deployment (7th): Quickbuilding a gadget no longer requires an action if done in response to being surprised or ambushed — once per encounter, free.
  • Expanded Toolkit (11th): You know two more gadgets than your known options allow, and you can hold one more built gadget at a time.
  • Lasting Work: Signature Device (15th): Once per week, spend a full day and appropriate materials to build one permanent, unique gadget with a lasting magical effect (not single-use) tailored to your specifications with the GM — a boot that deploys Rapid Ascent for free once per day, a ring that emits Smoke Bomb's cloud on command, or a glove with an always-on Shock Glove charge are all typical examples.
  • Magnum Opus: The Impossible Case (24th): A portable kit containing a permanent version of every gadget you've ever built, foldable into a case the size of a book. Requires a month of uninterrupted work and rare materials the GM determines.

Known Gadgets

  • Smoke Bomb — Creates a 15ft radius heavily obscured area for 1 minute
  • Shock Glove — Melee touch attack — 1d6 lightning damage, target saves or is stunned 1 round
  • Grapnel Line — Instantly close a 30ft gap to a solid anchor point, or pull a Medium or smaller target 15ft towards you
  • Flash Powder — 10ft radius burst — creatures save or are blinded for 1 round
  • Adhesive Charge — Thrown — target is Restrained until they break free with a Strength check
  • Distraction Decoy — A small mechanical decoy moves and makes noise on your command for 1 minute
  • Rapid Ascent Boots — One use — gain a 20ft vertical or horizontal jump-assisted burst of movement
  • Noisemaker Dart — Thrown to a point within 30ft — creates a loud, distinct noise there, no damage
  • Caltrop Scatter — Covers a 10ft square with caltrops — creatures entering without care take 1d4 damage and have their speed halved for the round
  • Pocket Ram — One use — a spring-loaded ram deals 1d8 damage to a door, lock, or barricade
  • Glass-Cutter Ring — Silently cuts a hole in glass or thin material large enough to reach through
  • Signal Flare — Fired into the air — visible for 1 mile in clear conditions, in a colour of your choosing

Designing a Custom Gadget

  • Benchmark: A combat gadget should land somewhere around a 1st-level spell's worth of effect — a single damage instance (1d6-2d6), a single save-or-suffer condition lasting 1 round, or an area effect no larger than 15ft radius. A utility gadget should solve one specific problem (noise, light, a locked door, a gap to cross) rather than several at once, and should almost always be single-use unless upgraded by Reusable Chassis.
